verses.gurmukhi: ਬੂੰਦ ਬੂੰਦ ਬਰਖ ਪਰਨਾਰੇ ਬਹਿ ਚਲੈ ਜਲ
verses.translit_en: boo(n)dh boo(n)dh barakh paranaare beh chalai jal

en.bdb: Every drop of rain joins the other and together they flow from the roof-tops into the streets and then in the storm water drains; And overflowing its banks, the water flows through many rivulets and join the main stream or rivers;

verses.gurmukhi: ਬਹੁਰਿਓ ਉਮਗਿ ਬਹੈ ਬੀਥੀ ਬੀਥੀ ਆਇ ਕੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: bahurio umag bahai beethee beethee aai kai ||

verses.gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਤੈ ਨੋਰਾ ਨੋਰਾ ਭਰਿ ਚਲਤ ਚਤੁਰ ਕੁੰਟ ਸਰਿਤਾ ਸਰਿਤਾ ਪ੍ਰਤਿ ਮਿਲਤ ਹੈ ਜਾਇ ਕੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: taa tai noraa noraa bhar chalat chatur ku(n)T saritaa saritaa prat milat hai jai kai ||

en.bdb: Water from every river flows to meet the sea, and once it falls in, it becomes one with it. It loses individuality. A person is recognized and praised according to one's traits. Similarly, a self-willed mean person and a Guru-oriented Sikh are recognized by their response and behavior.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਰਿਤਾ ਸਕਲ ਜਲ ਪ੍ਰਬਲ ਪ੍ਰਵਾਹ ਚਲਿ ਸੰਗਮ ਸਮੁੰਦ੍ਰ ਹੋਤ ਸਮਤ ਸਮਾਇ ਕੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: saritaa sakal jal prabal pravaeh chal sa(n)gam samu(n)dhr hot samat samai kai ||

en.bdb: Just as a diamond held in hand seems very small but when evaluated and sold, fills the coffers. Just as a cheque/draft carried on person has no weight but when cashed at the other end yields much money

verses.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਮੈ ਜੈਸੀਐ ਸਮਾਈ ਤੈਸੀਐ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਬਡਾਈ ਓਛੋ ਅਉ ਗੰਭੀਰ ਧੀਰ ਬੂਝੀਐ ਬੁਲਾਇ ਕੈ ॥੩੭੨॥
verses.translit_en: jaa mai jaiseeaai samaiee taiseeaai mahimaa baddaiee ochho aau ga(n)bheer dheer boojheeaai bulai kai ||372||

en.bdb: Just as a banyan tree seed is small but grows into a big tree that spreads all over, the significance of the lodging the true Guru's teachings in the hearts of obedient Sikhs of the Guru leads to reaching the divine court of the Lord. (372)
